contracts_to_satisfy.retrieval_hit_fields: existing fields preserved (record_id, partition, title, snippet, score, evidence_ids, retrieval_level); new fields may be ADDED only
contracts_to_satisfy.l0_boundary: project_id / partition / availability filtered BEFORE any scoring
contracts_to_satisfy.require_evidence: filters BOTH lexical and vector paths (no page without evidence_ids may enter results)

recall_audit.invariant: final_hits subset-of reranked subset-of deduped subset-of candidates

contracts_to_satisfy.degradation: when the vector path is unavailable, fall back to lexical AND mark the degradation in retrieval_level - never disguise a fallback as a vector success

deliverables: lexical path upgraded to real FTS/BM25 (replacing the naive substring _score)
vector recall path with the same partition boundary as the lexical path
same-partition graph expansion preserved with its existing semantics
RecallAuditRecord written per retrieve with the subset-chain invariant
explicit degradation state when the vector path is unavailable
task-local ledger, L3 record, progress log and handoff

positive: both lexical and vector paths produce traceable rankings on a fixed fixture
RecallAuditRecord subset chain holds: final_hits <= reranked <= deduped <= candidates
existing RetrievalHit fields unchanged for all consumers
negative: vector unavailable -> lexical fallback AND degradation state visible in results
determinism: same input + same index state yields the same result
